heading.title: Of the Powers of an Executor or Administrator

article.title: In respect of causes of action surviving deceased and debts due at death.
article.content:
305In respect of causes of action surviving deceased and debts due at death.

Section 305  ·  Part IX · Chapter VI  ·  page 82 of the Act
An executor or administrator has the same power to sue in respect of all causes of action that survive the deceased, and may exercise the same power for the recovery of debts as the deceased had when living.
